title: Machines of Buying and Selling Grace - Adam Behrens, New Generation
talk_summary: This is a product/vision talk about agentic commerce: how AI agents will act as buyers and sellers, requiring new payment rails, product-data APIs, and generative interfaces. It contains no engineering techniques for building or operating agent systems.

takeaways.technique: Unified API/MCP abstraction over heterogeneous backends
takeaways.what_they_do: They wrap many inconsistent merchant product systems (e.g., Samsung's 10 verticals) behind one consistent API plus an MCP server so any chat client can query it uniformly.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we do the work of abstracting that into a consistent API with cohesive endpoints that will work across any merchant

takeaways.what_they_do: Argues agents should be asked directly what they want rather than statistically inferring intent from clicks/keywords.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can actually just ask a user agent what it's trying to do. You don't have to statistically infer it
